description: A RAMB36E1 in simple dual port with both output registers on leaves ZINV_REGCLKB clear
exercises: the clock of the output register of a block RAM in simple dual port
a RAMB36E1 instantiated by hand, not inferred by yosys
why: Vivado clocks the output registers of a block RAM from REGCLKARDRCLK and leaves REGCLKB without a net in simple dual port, so ZINV_REGCLKB stays clear on both halves of the block. The engine applied the narrow-port rule (DOB_REG set, so the register clock follows CLKBWRCLK) and set that bit: a wrong bit in a bitstream that assembles all the same. Release 2026-10-22 carries it.
